definitions.explanation: A person who has just started learning or doing something and lacks experience.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{日本語|にほんご}の{初心者|しょしんしゃ}です。
examples.english: I am a beginner in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}けの{本|ほん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a book for beginners.

examples.japanese: このスキー{場|じょう}には{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{用|よう}のコースがある。
examples.english: This ski resort has courses for beginners.

notes:
{初心者|しょしんしゃ} is commonly used for any skill or activity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け: for beginners, beginner-friendly
- {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{用|よう}: for beginners (use)
- {初心者|しょしんしゃ}コース: beginner course
- {初心者|しょしんしゃ}マーク: beginner driver mark (green and yellow leaf symbol)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ビギナー: beginner (loanword, casual)
- {素人|しろうと}: amateur, layperson
